========================================
Statement-block macros and braced temporaries
========================================

void f(void) {
  ON_SCOPE_EXIT { cleanup(); };
  OStream s{&buf};
  Foo x{a, b};
  erase_fixture{}.run();
  if (cond) ON_SCOPE_EXIT { g(); };
  for (;;) LOG { flush(); };
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type))))
    (compound_statement
      (macro_braced_statement
        (identifier)
        (compound_statement
          (expression_statement
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (argument_list)))))
      (declaration
        (type_identifier)
        (init_declarator
          (identifier)
          (initializer_list
            (pointer_expression
              (identifier)))))
      (declaration
        (type_identifier)
        (init_declarator
          (identifier)
          (initializer_list
            (identifier)
            (identifier))))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (field_expression
            (compound_literal_expression
              (type_identifier)
              (initializer_list))
            (field_identifier))
          (argument_list)))
      (if_statement
        (condition_clause
          (identifier))
        (macro_braced_statement
          (identifier)
          (compound_statement
            (expression_statement
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list))))))
      (for_statement
        (macro_braced_statement
          (identifier)
          (compound_statement
            (expression_statement
              (call_expression
                (identifier)
                (argument_list)))))))))
